hero.headline: Limitless Monitoring
hero.subtitle: Ensure your services are always available with the most precise 30-second interval uptime monitoring.

why.headline: Every minute of downtime is real loss.
why.subtitle: Pulsewatch is here to ensure your business keeps running and customer trust remains intact.

financial.title: Stop Losing Revenue
financial.desc: Avoid financial losses due to failed transactions when your servers are down without your team knowing.

reputation.title: Maintain Trust
reputation.desc: A transparent status page shows your professionalism to customers and stakeholders during incidents.

operational.title: Respond Faster
operational.desc: Get alerts in seconds so engineering teams can fix problems before customers even notice.

bento.subtitle: Global infrastructure designed to detect anomalies in seconds. Don't let users be your first monitoring system.

feature1.title: 30-Second Global Detection
feature1.desc: Checks from 12 different global locations to ensure zero false alerts. Super fast intervals starting from 30 seconds.

feature2.title: Instant Notifications
feature2.desc: Send instant alerts to your favorite team communication platforms.

feature3.title: Public Status
feature3.desc: Full transparency with custom domains and live incident updates.

feature4.title: Incident Timeline
feature4.desc: Detailed downtime logs to help with Root Cause analysis.

feature5.title: Team Access
feature5.desc: Set roles and specific notifications for each member of the DevOps division.

deepdive.headline: Limitless Visibility
deepdive.subtitle: Every aspect of your infrastructure monitored in real-time. No more blind spots.

row1.title: Multi-protocol Checks
row1.desc: Monitor your services through multiple protocols including HTTP, TCP, and ICMP to ensure comprehensive coverage without limits.

row2.title: SSL & Domain Expiry
row2.desc: Never miss a renewal with automated monitoring and alerts for SSL certificates and domain registrations.

row3.title: Incident Management
row3.desc: Track every incident with a detailed timeline and technical notes to accelerate team response in the future.

pricing.headline: Pricing & Plans
pricing.subtitle: Choose a plan that fits your monitoring needs. Start for free, upgrade when you're ready.

free.title: Hobby
free.desc: Perfect for small and personal projects.

max.title: Max
max.desc: For critical infrastructure that demands zero tolerance.

footer.desc: Modern uptime monitoring platform for businesses that prioritize performance and customer trust.
